purpose: Read-only signing surface for the named human reviewer. Binds every screening decision artifact the reviewer actually saw to a HumanConfirmation record, preserving overrides and deferrals, and never signs on the reviewer's behalf.
stop_conditions: a decision artifact under the screening directory is not covered by the confirmation
an artifact hash changed after the reviewer saw it
the reviewer identity was not supplied explicitly by the person signing
a changed row carries no rationale or a deferred row carries no reason
title: Human Confirmation
